requiredScenarios.requirement: Authenticated subject with no optional domain rows receives a valid export with required metadata and empty sections.
All owned profiles are included and profile-scoped rows are limited to those owned profile ids.
Mobility, orders and other shared rows omit counterparty identifiers and operational third-party fields.
Messaging sections include only rows sent by subject-owned profiles and never dump full threads.
Any required query failure aborts the entire export; partial exports are forbidden.
A section exceeding the configured row bound fails closed instead of truncating silently.
Failure to resolve the authoritative Auth user aborts the export.
Provider tokens, refresh tokens, app metadata, push credentials, session tokens and internal storage references never appear.
Public or unbound DPO request rows remain excluded from self-service export and are never correlated by requester email.
Successful export records matrix/format metadata and an audit event without serializing secrets.

notes: Source coverage is complete, but source coverage alone does not certify release.
This contract does not authorize deployment or changing LGPD_EXPORT_MATRIX_IMPLEMENTATION_COMPLETE.
The authenticated production smoke blocker in issue #305 must not be bypassed to promote export rollout.
